== PC errata game-text citation ==
The [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json retained Players Committee Light.json record 259] (GEMP <code>1_152</code>, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab) matches the PC errata game text on [[Blaster (PC Errata)]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183258/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json Internet Archive]. The Sources citation is limited to that game text. The existing lore says “power packagedProduct”, while the retained record says “power packs”; this discrepancy remains unresolved and the lore has not been changed. All other article fields and relationship references are unchanged. This is a current-state PC source, not verification of the original printed face.
